name: Nothing to Lose but Our Chains

chains_study_1.name: Chains / Bodies Made for Others
chains_study_1.description: A scripted study with adult cyborg sex workers who already have their own preferences. Bodies Made for Others. Reuses procedural Dream Bodies. Controls make requests; refusals and material needs affect the result.
chains_study_1.qfep_connection: Variation in appearance does not determine who controls a body, a schedule or the shared infrastructure. The residents negotiate the conditions under which different forms can coexist.
interactions: Use the request dock; read the resident response; watch the changed body or infrastructure.
